questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: If (x − 7)2 = 49 and x > 7, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Take square roots: x − 7 = 7 (positive because x > 7), so x = 14.

questions.question: A climbing gym charges a one-time membership fee of $30 plus $24 for each visit. A member has paid $414 in total for the membership fee and visits. How many visits has the member paid for?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Set up 30 + 24n = 414. Then 24n = 384, so n = 16.

questions.question: What is 75% of 560?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

75% of 560 = 75/100 × 560 = 420.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = 3x2 − 5. What is the value of f(−4)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

f(−4) = 3(−4)2 − 5 = 3(16) − 5 = 43.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to (4x2 + 5x − 8) − (2x2 + 8x + 1)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Distribute the minus sign to every term of the second expression, then combine like terms: 2x2 − 3x − 9.

questions.question: For x > 0, the expression x9 · x3x1 is equivalent to xk. What is the value of k?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 11

Add exponents when multiplying and subtract when dividing: 9 + 3 − 1 = 11.

questions.question: If 5x + 9 = 69, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 12

Subtract 9 from both sides: 5x = 60. Divide by 5: x = 12.

questions.question: The price of a jacket was $180. The price was increased by 20%, and then the new price was decreased by 25%. What was the final price of the jacket?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

$180 × 65 = $216; then × 34 gives $162.

questions.question: The area covered by a mold colony, in square millimeters, doubles every 3 days. The initial area is 300. Which function gives the area P after d days?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

The starting value 300 is multiplied by 2 once every 3 days, so after d days it has been multiplied d/3 times.

questions.question: A theater sold adult tickets for $13 each and student tickets for $7 each. The equation 13a + 7b = 118 represents a day on which $118 was collected from a adult tickets and b student tickets. If 2 student tickets were sold that day, how many adult tickets were sold?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Substitute b = 2: 13a + 14 = 118, so 13a = 104 and a = 8.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question:
3x − 4y = 3
x + 4y = 17

If (x, y) is the solution to the system of equations above, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Solve by elimination or substitution: the solution is x = 5, y = 3. So x = 5.

questions.question:
The scatterplot shows data for 14 observations and a line of best fit.

The line of best fit has the equation y = 2x + 20. Based on the line of best fit, what is the predicted value of y when x = 8?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

Substitute x = 8: y = 2(8) + 20 = 36.

questions.question: If x2 + x4 = 6, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 8

Multiply both sides by 4: 2x + 1x = 24, so 3x = 24 and x = 8.

questions.question: Line k is defined by y = x + 3. Line j is parallel to line k and passes through the point (−1, 5). What is the y-intercept of line j?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 6

Parallel lines have equal slopes, so line j is y = x + b. Substituting (−1, 5): 5 = 1(−1) + b, so b = 6.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to (3x − 6)(x − 5)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

Multiply each term: 3x · 1x = 3x2, the middle terms give -15x + (−6x) = −21x, and −6 · −5 = 30.

questions.question: The equation x2 + 2x + y2 + 4y − 59 = 0 defines a circle in the xy-plane. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Complete the square: (x + 1)2 + (y + 2)2 = 1 + 4 + 59 = 64. The radius is 8.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question:
7x + 2y = 13
rx + 4y = 32

In the system of equations above, r is a constant. If the system has no solution, what is the value of r?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

A system of two linear equations has no solution when the lines are parallel: the coefficients of x and y are proportional but the constants are not. The y-coefficient is multiplied by 2, so r = 7 × 2 = 14 (and 13 × 2 = 26 ≠ 32).

questions.question: In isosceles triangle PQR, PQ = PR, and the measure of angle P is 100°. Side QR is extended past R to point S. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle PRS?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

The base angles are equal: (180 − 100) ÷ 2 = 40°. Angle PRS is supplementary to angle PRQ: 180 − 40 = 140°.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: In the equation x2 + kx + 81 = 0, k is a positive constant. If the equation has exactly one real solution, what is the value of k?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

A quadratic has exactly one real solution when its discriminant is 0: k2 − 4(1)(81) = 0, so k2 = 324 and k = 18.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question:
y = x2 − 3
y = −3x − 5

The graphs of the equations in the system intersect at two points. What is the sum of the x-coordinates of the two points?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: -3

Set the equations equal: x2 + 3x + 2 = 0. The sum of the solutions of x2 + bx + c = 0 is −b, which is −3.

questions.question: Cylinder A has radius 4 and height 3. Cylinder B has radius 12 and height 3. The volume of cylinder B is how many times the volume of cylinder A?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 9

Volume = πr2h. Multiplying the radius by 3 multiplies the volume by 32 = 9.

questions.skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
questions.question: What is the greatest integer value of x that satisfies the inequality 3x − 30 < 36?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Add 30: 3x < 66. Divide by 3: x < 22. The greatest integer less than 22 is 21.

questions.question: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of length 20 and one leg of length 12. What is the length of the other leg?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

122 + b2 = 202, so b2 = 256 and b = 16.

questions.skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
questions.question: A cargo lift can carry a load of at most 1,400 kilograms. A worker weighs 70 kilograms, and each package weighs 16 kilograms. Which inequality represents the possible numbers of packages, b, that the cargo lift can carry along with a worker?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

The total weight 70 + 16b can be at most (≤) 1,400 kilograms.

questions.question:
The graph of the linear function f is shown.

Which equation defines f?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

The line crosses the y-axis at (0, 1), so the y-intercept is 1. From (0, 1) to (4, −1) the slope is −2 ÷ 4 = −12.

questions.question:
The graph of y = f(x) is shown.

Which equation could define f?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

The vertex is (−1, −3) and the parabola opens downward, so f(x) = −(x + 1)2 − 3.

questions.question: A town's population is modeled by the function f(t) = 2,000(1.5)t, where f(t) is the number of people t years after the start. What is the value of f(2)?

questions.skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
questions.question: On a map, 4 centimeters represent 5 kilometers. How many centimeters on the map represent 40 kilometers?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 32

The ratio is 4 : 5. 40 is 8 times 5, so the answer is 8 × 4 = 32 centimeters.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question: A food bank received a total of 50 items: bags of rice costing $5 each and bags of beans costing $10 each. The total cost was $320. How many bags of beans were there?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 14

Let s and l be the numbers of bags of rice and bags of beans. Then s + l = 50 and 5s + 10l = 320. Multiply the first equation by 5 and subtract: 5l = 70, so l = 14.

questions.question: The expression (2x − 4)2 is equivalent to 4x2 + kx + 16, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

(a + b)2 = a2 + 2ab + b2, so k = 2(2)(−4) = −16.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question: The graphs of y = x + 2 and y = −4x + 12 intersect at the point (a, b) in the xy-plane. What is the value of a + b?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

Set the expressions equal: x + 2 = −4x + 12, so x = 2. Then y = 4, and a + b = 6.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: What is the sum of the solutions to 6x2 − 15x − 12 = 0?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

For ax2 + bx + c = 0, the sum of the solutions is −b/a = 52.

questions.question: In the equation 3x + k = 5x + 15, k is a constant. If x = 9 is the solution to the equation, what is the value of k?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Substitute x = 9: 27 + k = 60, so k = 33.

questions.question:
For the polynomial function p, the table shows some values of x and their corresponding values of p(x).

Which of the following must be a factor of p(x)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Because p(5) = 0, 5 is a zero of p, so by the factor theorem x − 5 is a factor of p(x).

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = x2 + 10x − 1. What is the minimum value of f(x)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: -26

Complete the square: f(x) = (x + 5)2 − 26. The minimum value occurs at x = −5 and equals −26.

questions.question: A triangle has a base of 4 meters and an area of 14 square meters. What is the height of the triangle, in meters?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 7

Area = ½ × base × height, so 14 = ½(4)(h) and h = 7.

questions.question: In the equation 2x + b = 2(x + 1) + 7, b is a constant. If the equation has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of b?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Expand the right side: 2x + 2 + 7 = 2x + 9. The equation is true for every x only when b = 9.

questions.skill: One-variable data: distributions and measures of center and spread
questions.question: A data set consists of the values 10, 13, 15, 21, 27, 32, 98. If the value 98 is removed from the data set, which of the following statements is true?
options: The mean decreases, and the median decreases.
The mean increases, and the median increases.
The mean decreases, and the median stays the same.
The mean stays the same, and the median decreases.
questions.correct: The mean decreases, and the median decreases.
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Removing the much larger value 98 lowers the mean a lot. The median changes from 21 (the 4th of 7 values) to the average of 15 and 21, which is 18, so it also decreases.

questions.question: In right triangle ABC, angle C is a right angle, BC = 15, AC = 8, and AB = 17. What is the value of tan A?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

tan A = BC/AC = 158 (SOH-CAH-TOA, measured from angle A).

questions.question: If 27x + 4 = 3x + 18, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Write both sides as powers of 3: 33(x + 4) = 3x + 18. So 3(x + 4) = x + 18, which gives x = 3.

questions.question: Line p is defined by −6x + 4y = 0. Line q is perpendicular to line p in the xy-plane. What is the slope of line q?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Write line p in slope-intercept form: y = 32x, so its slope is 32. Perpendicular slopes are negative reciprocals: −23.

questions.question: For x ≠ 4, the expression x2 − 16x − 4 is equivalent to g(x). What is the value of g(11)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 15

x2 − 16 = (x + 4)(x − 4), so g(x) = x + 4 and g(11) = 15.

questions.question: The value of a printing machine was $29,000 when it was new and decreases by $2,500 each year. After how many years will the value of the printing machine be $6,500?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 9

Solve 29000 − 2500t = 6500: 2500t = 22500, so t = 9.

questions.question:
The table shows how a group of commuters traveled on a set of trips, by day type.

If one of the weekend trips is selected at random, what is the probability that the train was chosen?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

There are 53 weekend trips, and the train was chosen on 22 of them: 2253.
